title: One approximation for a coefficient and its noise amplitude
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib finite-interval approximation supplement. One approximation for a coefficient and its noise amplitude.
target_statement: Under the same assumptions there is one globally smooth function \(g\), positive and at most \(C+\varepsilon\) on \([a,b]\), for which both the integrated coefficient error and the integrated squared error of the noise amplitude \(\sqrt{2f}\) are less than \(\varepsilon\).
